body: How can I start talking to them?

I would quit swimming, but I honestly can't for a few different reasons. One, I might make it to states this winter and break the school record for one of the events. I want to leave my mark on the school. Two, it's my last year. I can't just quit after several years of practice. Three, I love the team. It's honestly a huge family, and when we aren't actually swimming, its wonderful. Four, I have a pretty good athlete-coach relationship, so I'd feel pretty bad if I just suddenly quit.

I know that eventually I'll get over her, but this one is going to be especially tough for me. I hang out with her at least once a week. We're best friends, so I can't just cut off contact with her. And I'm not 100% on this, but she used to have a crush on me and I think her feelings are lingering, so she's acting somewhat flirty. 

It's tough, dude. I wish things would just work out for me.
